name: COMSEC Maintenance Technician
explanation: COMSEC is communications security: the equipment that encrypts military messages. A maintenance technician keeps that equipment working. Time in this NEC: 11 years and 7 months.
criteria: Awarded after COMSEC maintenance school and work in the specialty.

name: NSW Communications Technician
explanation: NSW means Naval Special Warfare. This NEC is a communications technician who supports those units. It is not the same thing as being a SEAL. The shadowbox lists 9613 as the last NEC, and the notes on this career call it the favorite. Time in this NEC: 7 years and 11 months.
criteria: Awarded for communications work in support of Naval Special Warfare.

name: FECL Calibration Technician
explanation: FECL is a field calibration lab. The job is to test and adjust the Navy's electronic measuring gear so other repairs can be trusted. The notes on this career call 1589 the primary NEC. Time in this NEC: 7 years and 6 months.
criteria: Awarded after calibration school and work in a field calibration activity.

name: Miniature Electronic Repair Technician
explanation: Component-level repair of small electronic assemblies: finding the failed part on a circuit card and replacing it, rather than swapping the whole box.
criteria: Awarded after miniature-repair training and work in that shop.

name: Portuguese-Brazilian language
explanation: A Navy language qualification for Portuguese as spoken in Brazil. Time in this qualification: 3 years and 11 months.
criteria: Awarded after the Navy recognizes the language skill.

name: GWOT Support Assignment — base combat unit member
explanation: A code used to record a Global War on Terrorism support assignment as a member of a base combat unit. Time recorded: one year.
criteria: Entered for that assignment. It is an administrative NEC, not a technical school.

name: Electronics Technician, no specific NEC
explanation: ET-0000 means the Electronics Technician rating with no additional NEC in effect. The shadowbox shows it on the 2008–2009 individual augmentee tour with the Army.
criteria: Used when no specialty code applies to the assignment.
